card.name: Start of drug names in lists
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name split into parts, right after a comma, 'and' or 'taking' in a drug interaction list. Mostly 'cl' of clonidine, also 'ap' of apomorphine and 'Am' of amiodarone.

modes.label: cl in clonidine
modes.description: The 'cl' that begins clonidine, listed after beta-blockers or 'and'.

card.writes: It promotes odd word-start pieces, mostly non-English, so it adds little clear output effect beyond continuing the drug name.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of a drug name, like clonidine, when it is named in an interaction list.
